title: Peujabat Taman nyan
intro: Lam saboh taman nyang subur, saboh masyarakat jipeugot janji nyang suci. Teuma tekad awaknyan teu-uji watée keuheundak ilahi jicampur tangan, ji-ubah karunia awaknyan jeuet keu tanoh nyang tan.
clues: Kamoe geubri beureukat deungon taman nyang le that, teuma kamoe jeuet keu sombong.
Kamoe peugot reuncana keu kamoe panen hana meubagi-bagi keu ureung gasien.
Kamoe beurangkat beungoh that, yakin keu skema kamoe.
Teuma watèë kamoë trôh, kamoë meurumpok taman kamoë ka hancô lam siuroë.
Kamoe sadar keusalahan kamoe dan mulai saleng meusalah.
Akhéjih kamoe meutobat, tapi peulajaran nyan ka treb that.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Saboh taman ka meuubah jeuet keu abe .
Angen raya nyang jipeuhabéh bak-bak kayée .
trial.answer: Saboh taman ka meuubah jeuet keu abe .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Awaknyan ka meutobat teuma gadôh taman awaknyan .
Awaknyan ka ji ubah jeuet keu kera .
outcome.answer: Awaknyan ka meutobat teuma gadôh taman awaknyan .

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
